Keep exactly one report per triggered entry, the `check/host-<nn>.txt` spool and the existing base_red box message. Change only the base-red report, mirroring how `VerificationGate` excludes `r.base_red` results from its verdict.

Update `test_base_red_entry_is_preexisting` so it expects a `pass` report with no findings. Also make Check fail on another gate while a host entry is red at base, then assert `_prior_findings` or `prior_attempts` omits the base-red finding.

Keep real failures as they are: a hard or soft entry that is green at base keeps its `fail` report and findings. The ticket requires a soft failure to record `fail` while Check proceeds, so scope the report replacement to `baseline.rc != 0` only.
